answers.core: It doesn't have to be core, but I think a lot of people would use it as it's an easy way to make downloadable content that you could sell. Making a game takes months; making a wallpaper takes a few hours to a few days.
answers.workaround: I do not know. You could possibly make a separate program for it, assuming that it is simple.

title: Add support for exporting projects as live/interactive wallpapers
